derivation.trade_id: Joined from the latest C6 OPEN or REVERSE_ENTRY ex-ante trade_id with no matching exit at the row timestamp. Empty when position is FLAT.
derivation.equity_at_open: Joined from that same C6 OPEN or REVERSE_ENTRY ex-ante equity_at_open. Empty when position is FLAT.
derivation.mark_kind: GENESIS when observation_id is LEDGER_GENESIS. FILL when observation_id equals an entry or exit event observation_id (OPEN, REVERSE_ENTRY, FLAT_EXIT, REVERSE_EXIT, HARD_STOP_EXIT). BAR_1H otherwise. equity_v2_1 has no OHLC proxy rows.
derivation.mark_honesty_label: Always RECORDED_MARK. A NOT_TICK_LOW proxy label needs a later additive schema version and a new filename.
derivation.mark_rule_id: MARK_RULE_C7_V1 passes through. UNBOUND or empty is shown as C7_NOT_READY and is not relabeled MARK_RULE_C7_V1.
derivation.sample_class: Copied from the on-disk row. The scoring filter requires FORWARD_LIVE_SHADOW.
